_about: George Berkeley (1685-1753): The Works of George Berkeley, including his posthumous works, ed. Alexander Campbell Fraser (Oxford: Clarendon, 1901, 4 vols.). Vol. 1 clean Gutenberg; vols. 2-4 raw IA OCR. The Adler shelf's Principles (PG 4723) is held there; the separate Gutenberg texts of the New Theory of Vision, Three Dialogues, Querist and Bermuda Proposal (PG 4722, 4724, 4543, 31848) are all inside Fraser's edition and are not taken as second witnesses. No uids minted.
